articles.title: NYSE owner takes steps to bring Hyperliquid perpetual futures to U.S.
articles.snippet: The planned ICE[XYZ] venue would offer 24/7 perpetual futures on stocks, commodities and crypto, pending CFTC approval. ICE is investing in Trade[XYZ].

articles.title: Solana wallet Solflare pledges to pay missed rewards on staked $160 million after validator goes offline
articles.snippet: About 1.56 million SOL sat on a validator that stopped earning, and the wallet still hasn’t named the firm that held its keys.

articles.title: Former Swift CEO joins stablecoin firm OpenTrade as chairman
articles.snippet: Lazaro Campos takes the board role as the London-based company reports $300 million in assets locked and more than $1 billion in annual transaction volume.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $137M, pushing October back into the green
articles.snippet: Bitcoin ETFs drew $424 million over three days, lifting October net inflows to $111 million despite a hawkish Federal Reserve decision and weaker crypto sentiment.

articles.title: Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair
articles.snippet: CFTC chair Mike Selig says autonomous AI agents could challenge financial rules built around human traders, and regulators need to adapt.
